rationale: The bid-ask spread of 113 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday edge extremely difficult to capture — the trade starts roughly 1.1% in the hole before price moves at all. The stock has already gapped down 2.44% and sold off hard to near today's low, with price sitting at only 12.9% of the daily range and just 1.75% above the session low, offering poor risk/reward for a long (limited upside confirmation, close to support but no bounce momentum) and limited short edge (already deeply extended from open). The elevated relative volume (8x) and VIX pressure suggest continued volatility, but the wide spread and lack of a clear directional setup with defined structure make this an unfavorable entry at this moment.
